name: False Christians
overview: Scripture warns believers to be discerning of those who profess faith but lack true obedience and love, as Jesus cautions that not all who call Him 'Lord' will enter the kingdom, but only those who do the Father's will (Matthew 7:21). False Christians are likened to false prophets who appear harmless but are inwardly destructive (Matthew 7:15), and their devotion is often empty, honoring God with lips while their hearts remain distant (Matthew 15:8). True discipleship is marked by genuine love for one another (John 13:35), in contrast to those influenced by the devil's deceit and falsehoods (John 8:44). Believers are called to exercise judgment wisely, avoiding hypocrisy, to guard the purity of the faith (Matthew 7:1).
